about: One puff of a campfire's smoke: a thin, wispy breath of grey that rolls up off the logs, opens and thins away. The hearth's wisp is many of these, each its own age; lit six ways (six_way), not glowing.
channels: map 0 (<set>.png): R right +X, G top +Z, B back +Y, A alpha; map 1 (<set>.opposite.png): R left, G bottom, B front, A glow
